lead: A `-p nvs-cli` test whose program `spawn script`s needs a scheduler and a reactor; `nvs_host::Isolate::run` alone installs neither.
body: Neither failure names it: `script.spawn` `is not granted`, then `needs a scheduler on this thread`. Copy `crates/nvs-cli/src/script.rs`'s `run_serving`: `Scheduler::new()`, `spawn(granting_ctx(), TaskRoot::Request, …)`, `reactor::install(Reactor::new()?)`, `run_until_idle`.
